neighbours.label: character and term names in TV/anime fan-plot text (Star Trek, Avatar, Bleach, Naruto)
fire: In the next episode, Seven of Nine helps B'Elanna repair the warp core.
Spock and McCoy argue on the bridge while Kirk negotiates with the Klingons.
Later, Aang uses waterbending to free Katara from the Fire Nation prison.
After the time skip, Naruto returns to Konoha and trains with Jiraiya.
In DS9, Quark runs the bar on the Promenade while Odo keeps an eye on him.
Eventually Zuko joins Team Avatar and teaches Aang firebending.
Then Byakuya releases Senbonzakura and faces Renji at the Soul Society gate.
Captain Picard orders Geordi to divert power from the holodeck to the shields.
quiet: In the next session, the Senate helps the governor repair the state budget.
Napoleon and Wellington met at Waterloo while Blücher marched from the east.
Later, Gandhi led thousands of followers on the long march to the sea.
After the war, Churchill returned to Parliament and wrote his memoirs.
In Dickens, Scrooge runs the counting house while Cratchit copies letters.
Eventually Elizabeth accepts Darcy at the end of Pride and Prejudice.
Then Odysseus strings his bow and faces the suitors in the hall at Ithaca.
The captain ordered the engineers to divert power to the pumps as the ship flooded.

notes: Probe: Avatar 'airbend' 0.93, Star Trek 'Tuvok' 0.60, Bleach 'Espada' 0.43, 'Worf and Data' 0.34; real history (Nelson, Normandy) 0.02, Moby-Dick plot 0.06, Beowulf 0.01, news 0.02. The - pole leans to legendary/classical names (Beowulf, Gilgamesh): modern franchise fiction vs older literature.
